label: release-readiness-20261028
scope: Authored bilingual regression controls, synthesized with macOS voices. Speed, game-like effects and speaker overlap are synthetic stress controls. Japanese speaker changes are pitch changes of one voice. Not live-speech, accent diversity or human quality validation. Audio hashes freeze each rendered set before measurement.
cachePolicy: Audio and text run in separate passes; translator disposed and reinitialized between passes. No source examples are used for warmup.
